footballer.glb is built by scripts/build_footballer.py from:

- Universal Base Characters [Standard] by Quaternius (male body, eyes, hair meshes and their
  textures), https://quaternius.itch.io/universal-base-characters
- Universal Animation Library [Standard] by Quaternius (skeleton and clips, via
  web/vendor/quaternius/mannequin.glb), https://quaternius.itch.io/universal-animation-library

Both are released under CC0 1.0 Universal (Public Domain Dedication),
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/ , as stated in License_Standard.txt of each
pack (downloaded 18 Oct 2026).

Our changes (rebinding, kit regions, UVs, decimation) are released under the repository's MIT licence.

human.glb is built by scripts/build_humans.py from the MakeHuman system assets (base mesh,
modelling targets, game-engine rig weights, eyes, eyebrows, eyelashes, hair afro01, short01,
short02, short04, shoes05 and the young light-skinned male skin texture), downloaded on 18 Oct 2026
from https://files.makehumancommunity.org/asset_packs/makehuman_system_assets/makehuman_system_assets_cc0.zip
and with the MPFB 2.0.18 extension (http://static.makehumancommunity.org/mpfb.html). Each asset
file says "This asset was explicitly released as CC0 in september 2020", and the pack's index
lists every asset as CC0. MPFB itself (GPL-3.0-or-later) is a build tool only: none of its code
is shipped. Skeleton and clips come from web/vendor/quaternius/mannequin.glb as above.

Our changes (retargeting, garments, textures, decimation) are released under the repository's MIT licence.
